privacy.notes: Wake relay may receive sender Tox public key (not full Tox ID with checksum) via optional &from= query param and FCM data fields sender_pubkey/from. Used by mobile clients to route the notification to the correct chat. Message plaintext is never sent. From Android 0.2.64 / iOS 1.4.34 a wake may carry `preview`, an end-to-end encrypted preview (ChaCha20-Poly1305 under a key only the recipient device can derive), and `pid`, an opaque event id; the relay forwards both as FCM data khq_pv/khq_pid and cannot read them.
